req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-027 requires that POST /players/ returns HTTP 201 and sets a Location header. Reading the source, the route sets response.headers['Location'] = f'/players/squadnumber/{player.squad_number}' (NOT /players/{new_id}). Tests must verify: (1) positive – valid new player yields 201 + correct Location header value; (2) negative – duplicate squad_number yields 409 and no Location header; (3) boundary – squad_number at minimum plausible integer boundary (squad_number=0 or squad_number=27, just outside existing data) still produces correct Location; (4) additional DT case – missing required field yields 422 with no Location. The Location header format is '/players/squadnumber/{squad_number}' per source. Tests assert exact status codes, exact header values, and exact response body fields to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains id, firstName, lastName, squadNumber=99
trace: R-PLAYER-027: Location header set on 201 Created
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile, shutil
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "location" in {k.lower() for k in r.headers}
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_contains_squad_number_not_uuid
preconditions: Database contains players with squad numbers 1-26
expected: Location header is '/players/squadnumber/50' (uses squad_number, not UUID)
Location header does NOT start with '/players/' followed by a UUID pattern
trace: R-PLAYER-027: verifies exact Location header format; catches mutations that swap squad_number for id or change path prefix
tests.executable:
import re
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_location_header_contains_squad_number_not_uuid():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Exact",
        "lastName": "Format",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "team": "Chelsea",
        "league": "Premier League"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location is not None
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/50"
    uuid_pattern = re.compile(
        r'^/players/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    )
    assert not uuid_pattern.match(location)
    assert location.startswith("/players/squadnumber/")
    assert location.endswith("/50")

test_post_player_location_header_contains_squad_number_not_uuid()

tests.name: test_post_player_boundary_squad_number_26_conflict_and_25_new
preconditions: Database contains player with squad_number=26 (max pre-loaded)
Squad number 26 already exists; squad number 28 does not
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=28 (max+2, expect 201 with correct Location)
expected: First POST returns HTTP 409 (boundary: existing max)
Second POST returns HTTP 201 with Location='/players/squadnumber/28'
trace: R-PLAYER-027: BVA at max existing boundary; tests both sides of the duplicate-check condition
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_boundary_squad_number_26_conflict_and_28_new():
    payload_conflict = {
        "firstName": "Aditya",
        "lastName": "Mehta",
        "squadNumber": 26,
        "position": "Defensive Midfield"
    }
    r_conflict = client.post("/players/", json=payload_conflict)
    assert r_conflict.status_code == 409
    loc_conflict = r_conflict.headers.get("location") or r_conflict.headers.get("Location")
    assert loc_conflict is None

    payload_new = {
        "firstName": "NewBoundary",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 28,
        "position": "Right Winger"
    }
    r_new = client.post("/players/", json=payload_new)
    assert r_new.status_code == 201
    location = r_new.headers.get("location") or r_new.headers.get("Location")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/28"
    body = r_new.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 28

test_post_player_boundary_squad_number_26_conflict_and_28_new()
